## {{< fa circle-check >}} Step 5: Setup check

About 20 minutes. Due by [**{{< var session.setup-check-deadline >}}**]{.highlight-yellow}.

You accept the invitation to the course organisation, copy the workshop repository to your laptop (Git calls this a clone) and tick off what you have done. Your steps are in an issue in the workshop repository, with a box to tick for each. Step 6 shows where to find it after you have accepted the invitation.

## Before you start: one folder for all repositories

Create a folder named `gitrepos` in your **Documents** folder. Every repository you clone goes into it. Inside `gitrepos`, create a folder named `gh-org-{{< var course.code >}}`. It holds the repositories of the organisation `{{< var course.code >}}`.

```
Documents/
└── gitrepos/
    └── gh-org-{{< var course.code >}}/
        ├── workshop/
        └── teaching-your-username/
```

The folder shows where a repository belongs on GitHub. Do not put `gitrepos` into a folder that syncs with iCloud, OneDrive or Dropbox. Git and the sync get in each other's way, and changes are lost.

## Steps

1. Accept the invitation. After you have given your GitHub username in the [survey](01-survey.qmd), GitHub sends you an email with the button **Join \@{{< var course.code >}}**. Or open <https://github.com/orgs/{{< var course.code >}}/invitation> while signed in.
2. Open GitHub Desktop. Choose the menu **File**, **Clone Repository...**, then the tab **URL**.
3. Type `{{< var course.code >}}/workshop` into the first field.
4. Look at **Local Path** before you click anything else. Click **Choose...**, go to **Documents**, then **gitrepos**, select `gh-org-{{< var course.code >}}` and confirm.
5. **Local Path** now ends in `gitrepos/gh-org-{{< var course.code >}}/workshop`. GitHub Desktop adds the name of the repository. Click **Clone**. GitHub Desktop shows **Current Repository: workshop** at the top left.
6. Open the [issues of the workshop repository](https://github.com/{{< var course.code >}}/workshop/issues) and click the one with your username in its title. Tick the boxes for Steps 3 to 5.

You are done with this step when the three boxes are ticked.

## Stuck?

- **No invitation.** I can only invite you once I have your username. Complete the [survey](01-survey.qmd) and look again an hour later.
- **GitHub Desktop says the repository was not found.** The invitation is not accepted yet, or GitHub Desktop is signed in with a different account. Check **Settings** or **Options**, tab **Accounts**.
- **The path ends in a folder named Untitled** (macOS). Click **Choose...** again and select `gh-org-{{< var course.code >}}` without typing a name.
- Anything else: write what you see as a comment in your issue, with a screenshot.

Next: [Step 6](06-your-repository.qmd).

If the setup is not finished by the workshop, come anyway. You sit with a neighbour who has it and follow on their laptop.
